title: Ninety-Six Ways to Measure a Scribe: Fragmented Evaluation of Ambient Scribes in Healthcare
abstract: arXiv:2611.14284v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes have moved rapidly from experimental pilots to enterprise-wide deployment across health systems, promising reduced documentation burden and improved clinician experience. While research evaluating these tools has expanded quickly, there are no agreed-upon protocols or standardized metrics for assessing their performance, making it difficult to compare findings or cumulatively synthesize evidence across studies. Across 54 recent evaluation studies, we identify ten evaluation dimensions and 40 distinct metrics, operationalized in 96 different ways-35 of them (36%) used by only a single study. Assessment is dominated by documentation efficiency and time, measured in 44 of 54 studies. The other dimensions appear at broadly similar rates (16-24 studies each), and safety and clinical outcome least consistently of all. translated_title: 测量记录助手的96种方法：医疗领域环境式AI记录助手评估的碎片化现状
translated_abstract: 环境式人工智能记录助手已迅速从实验性试点项目发展到整个医疗系统的全面部署，有望减轻文档记录负担并改善临床医生的使用体验。尽管针对这些工具的评估研究迅速增多，但目前尚无公认的评估方案或标准化指标来衡量其性能，导致各研究之间的结果难以比较，证据也难以进行累积性综合。通过分析54项近期的评估研究，我们识别出十个评估维度和40种不同的指标，并以96种不同的方式进行操作化——其中35种（占36%）仅被单一研究使用。现有评估主要集中于文档记录效率和时间，54项研究中有44项对此进行了测量。其他维度出现的频率大致相近（每个维度16至24项研究），其中安全性和临床结果的评估一致性最低。而对更广泛医疗体系产生的连锁影响，例如对患者诊疗结局的影响……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究系统分析了54项医疗环境式AI记录助手的评估研究，发现评估维度和指标高度碎片化——共十个维度、40种指标、96种操作化方式，其中36%仅被单一研究使用，且缺乏标准化评估协议，导致各研究结果难以比较、证据难以综合。
en_tdlr: Analyzing 54 recent evaluation studies of ambient AI scribes in healthcare, this paper reveals highly fragmented assessment practices—ten dimensions and 40 metrics operationalized in 96 ways, 36% of which appear in only a single study—underscoring the absence of standardized evaluation protocols that impedes cross-study comparison and cumulative evidence synthesis.
